subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is current main's post-release Discord gateway lifecycle hardening sufficient after live 1005/1006 recovery proof, or should maintainers keep this issue open for another gateway self-reconnect fix?
rationale: The issue has credible release-level live reproductions and current main has adjacent fixes, but the review cannot safely infer that the exact long-running Discord self-reconnect failure is fixed without maintainer-owned live proof.

options.title: Keep Open For Current-Main Live Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or QA run captures a real or transport-harnessed 1005/1006 close recovering without a process restart on current main.

options.title: Sponsor A Focused Fix Now
options.body: Treat the release repros as sufficient and sponsor a narrow Discord gateway lifecycle fix with live proof before closing.

options.title: Close After Maintainer-Owned Proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers can attach proof that current main already self-recovers from the reported close path.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Current-Main Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or QA run captures a real or transport-harnessed 1005/1006 close recovering without a process restart on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent and repeated contributor on the Discord lifecycle, reconnect, and delivery-hardening path with maintainer-facing proof comments.
